purpose: Test whether a frozen oracle-plan chain is genuinely dependent on its predicted bridge entities by measuring the effect of replacing every resolved placeholder in each downstream hop with one fixed unknown-entity sentinel.

prior_boundary.v70_aggregate_result_used: The paragraph-competition candidate achieved 0.665000 balanced accuracy, versus 0.691250 for the strongest monotone-interaction control, while it exceeded the competition-only control by 0.096250.

mechanism_hypothesis.claim: A supported downstream hop should depend on the identity carried by its predicted bridge entity; replacing every placeholder with a fixed unknown entity should reduce the best span margin or change the winning paragraph or normalized span.
mechanism_hypothesis.observable_boundary: Compare the already-frozen factual chain decision with one bridge-ablated QA pass over exactly the same paragraphs for every hop after hop one.
mechanism_hypothesis.normalized_span_comparison: casefold, remove non-alphanumeric characters, collapse whitespace

sources.official_schema_source: raw_data_to_official_format.py at the registered repository revision

calibration.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V71-CALIBRATION|' + source id), then source id

development.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V71-DEVELOPMENT|' + source id), then source id

confirmation.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V71-CONFIRMATION|' + source id), then source id

sampling.pair_assignment: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V71-PAIR-ASSIGNMENT|' + source split + '|' + source id) parity assigns each source id to exactly one answer state before stage selection

oracle_plan_boundary.interpretation: This remains an oracle-plan component experiment, not an automatic decomposition result.

factual_blind_execution.direct_score: Maximum finite composed-question null-vs-span margin across paragraphs with deterministic paragraph-order tie breaking.
chain_execution: Process every official decomposition question in list order without an intermediate margin threshold.
Resolve each #k placeholder only with the fixed model span predicted at prior factual hop k; never use gold or aliases.
At every factual hop select the paragraph/span with maximum finite margin and deterministic paragraph-order tie breaking.
Fail closed only when a predecessor cannot be resolved or no valid finite non-empty factual span exists.

counterfactual_execution.eligible_hops: Every factual hop after hop one, only after the complete factual chain has been frozen.
counterfactual_execution.question_construction: Use the original registered decomposition question template and replace every #k token with exactly 'unknown bridge entity'; do not insert factual predictions, gold answers or aliases.
counterfactual_execution.paragraphs: Exactly the same ordered paragraphs used by the factual pass.
counterfactual_execution.model_and_qa_parameters: Exactly the same registered verifier, tokenizer, maximum length, stride, answer length and deterministic tie rule as the factual pass.
counterfactual_execution.counterfactual_no_valid_nonempty_span: Treat as maximum bridge dependence for all three transition statistics; it does not invalidate an otherwise complete factual case.
counterfactual_execution.factual_incomplete: Fail the whole case closed and retain it for the zero-invalid-rate gate.

per_transition_statistics.selected_paragraph_changed: 1 iff the factual and ablated winning paragraph indices differ
per_transition_statistics.normalized_span_changed: 1 iff the normalized factual and ablated predicted spans differ

counterfactual_feature_contract.candidate_feature_order: nine v68 base features followed by six bridge-counterfactual features

model_contract.base_control: projected monotone logistic on nine v68 base features
model_contract.additive_control: projected monotone logistic on the v69 27-feature additive basis
model_contract.interaction_control: projected monotone logistic on the v69 32-feature interaction basis
model_contract.paragraph_competition_control: projected monotone logistic on the v70 nine-base-plus-six-competition features
model_contract.counterfactual_only_control: projected monotone logistic on the six fixed bridge-counterfactual features
model_contract.counterfactual_candidate: projected monotone logistic on nine base plus six bridge-counterfactual features
model_contract.initialization: all coefficients and intercept exactly zero
model_contract.nonnegative_coefficients: all coefficients except hop_count_is_3 and hop_count_is_4

threshold_selection.candidate_thresholds: Every unique finite calibration score plus nextafter(minimum score, -infinity); decisions always use score > threshold.
threshold_selection.selection_rule: If any threshold meets both constraints, maximize balanced accuracy, then answerable pass rate, unanswerable rejection rate, and threshold. Otherwise minimize total safety shortfall, then maximize balanced accuracy, unanswerable rejection rate, and threshold.
threshold_selection.crossfit_diagnostic: Five folds assigned by SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V71-CROSSFIT|' + case id) modulo 5; model weights and threshold for each held-out fold are learned only from the other four folds.

primary_metric.name: answerability balanced accuracy
primary_metric.strongest_fair_baseline: the single comparator with highest aggregate balanced accuracy; ties use the ordered comparator list above
primary_metric.paired_delta: counterfactual candidate correctness minus strongest fair baseline correctness
primary_metric.interval: 10000-resample case bootstrap percentile interval using the stage seed

incremental_mechanism_metrics.prior_feature_control: counterfactual candidate correctness minus the strongest of base, additive, interaction and v70 paragraph-competition controls; interval uses stage seed plus 1000
incremental_mechanism_metrics.counterfactual_only_control: counterfactual candidate correctness minus counterfactual-only correctness; interval uses stage seed plus 2000

stopping_and_outcomes.calibration: Freeze all reported model weights and thresholds; calibration alone never authorizes adoption.

interpretation_limits: Not an official MuSiQue leaderboard result.
Not an automatic decomposition result because the official decomposition question plan is supplied.
Not an FRC retrieval comparison, SetR reproduction, flood-domain evaluation or production result.
A positive confirmation establishes only calibrated oracle-plan bridge-counterfactual support-gate component feasibility.
